flows.title: Create a spreadsheet
steps: Open the Sheets home screen at sheets.google.com.
Click New. This creates and opens the new spreadsheet. Opening sheets.google.com/create does the same.

flows.title: Sort a sheet by a column
steps: At the top, right-click the letter of the column to sort by.
Click Sort sheet A to Z or Sort sheet Z to A.

flows.title: Insert a chart
steps: Select the cells to include in the chart.
To change the chart type, double-click the chart, click Setup on the right, and choose a type under Chart type.
